id: title:jakesciotto:send filter all when listing netlify sites

review.posthog_relevance: Netlify warehouse ingestion and downstream warehouse fan-outs
review.reason: Adds a required API parameter (`filter=all`) to Netlify warehouse ingestion requests. P1.F2.H2 introduces the configuration field, P1.F1.H2 applies it to the ingestion request, and P1.F1.H4 propagates it to warehouse fan-outs. This prevents warehouse ingestion failures and missing team-scoped data, supporting warehouse reliability.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on the provided observation that the parameter is required; no test execution or runtime behavior is observed. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness fix rather than broader systemic changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration field and its use to support a required API parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: Netlify warehouse ingestion: the Netlify API requires `filter=all` on the `/sites` endpoint to return team-scoped sites; without it, the warehouse would miss team sites and break downstream fan-outs. This hunk supplies the missing parameter.

observations.behavior: Updates the resource builder to pass the new extra_params into the Netlify API request.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the configuration supplied in P1.F2.H2 to the actual HTTP request, ensuring the warehouse ingestion uses the corrected parameters.

observations.behavior: Updates the fan-out resource builder to pass extra_params and the parent site ID as a resolve parameter.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies the same parameter injection to fan-out requests, while also resolving the parent site ID for the warehouse ingestion of child resources.
